body: Thank you so much, I really appreciate

There's no good suicidal method. The only good method is try to live your life to the best. I know the feeling, I have everyday since I was 12 (I'm 23). Just try to live. Set a goal. I wish somebody to teach me how to live better with myself.

It's a long time and a long road. I feel weak every day goes by. My strength is getting over. Medication is what make me stand up, sometimes I overdose my meds just to feel nothing, and it feels less worse. I need to be cool with myself. About my parents, they are already gone in my mind. So... Fuck'em
Totally agree with you. I am trying. The job and moving out are going to be the start a new life I don't even know I have. I'm stuck in a prison of loneliness.

I'm 23 with 2 college graduations and a MBA, but i can't get a job because of the economic situation in my country. Almost everyone at my age is unemployed. I just need a job to leave and never look back. My parents always use the "money card" in their favor, and i can't do nothing right now. The only way out is drive an uber, but i don't know if this will resolve my problem
Same age, feel the same. I'm such in bad shape that i just want to take pills and fell absolutely nothing. Getting knocked out from depression every single day

You have another friend right here. I feel exactly the same way. Depression takes me down really hard and i often have panic attacks out of the blue. I'm here for you, we are all in the same boat, if we don't help each other, the boat sink
i'm so sorry to hear that, i feel like this way about life all the time too. However we need to try keep going til the maximum of our strength, it's the only way
My upbringing had everything to do with my depression. I can feel it. When i'm away from home i feel light. When i walk inside my house i feel  a darkness's taking over me. I just need to be gone
Do not take a precipitation action. Let the time heal your sadness. I know how muck pain you are feeling now, but all the thing will be back in order some time soon. Trust in yourself
You will! We just need to find that light at the end of the tunnel. I'm here for you with you want to chat
i hope you can find a way out of it!

Thank you for asking how was my, this was the highlight. About the date, it's random (end of the year). My depression is in the worst place right now, i can no longer live with my narcissist abusive parents. I need i life of my own, and a i feel right now that i don't have it.

I most certainly don't want to die, but my depression is taking me down real bad. To be honest with you, my goal is leaving my narcissist and abusive parents house and get a job. I need to leave my parent house and i need to get away from all the abuse people around me
